brief:
The UN's Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher warned of escalating humanitarian dangers in Gaza during the coming winter, Shehab Wire reported. Fletcher cited deteriorating shelter conditions, overcrowding, and the spread of disease as mounting threats to the civilian population as temperatures drop.

Winter weather will compound existing challenges across the enclave, where displacement has strained infrastructure and displaced persons face exposure in inadequate facilities. Fletcher's warning reflects growing international concern over the capacity of aid systems to meet basic needs during months of severe cold and heightened health risks in densely packed shelters across Gaza.
